title: Understanding the Bootstrap Confidence Interval
text: To construct a bootstrap confidence interval, we need to use the percentiles from the bootstrap distribution. Here, the $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles are given as $$-2.2$$ and $$1.9$$. These values help us determine the range of our confidence interval.

title: Calculating the Standard Error
text: The standard error of the sample mean is calculated using the formula SE(\hat{\theta})=\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}. Given $$\sigma=2$$ and $$n=100$$, try calculating the standard error.

title: Choosing the Correct Interval
text: Which of the following intervals correctly uses the percentiles and standard error to form a 95% confidence interval?

title: Applying the Percentiles
text: To find the confidence interval, apply the percentiles to the sample mean and standard error. The formula is \hat{\theta} $$\frac{plus}{minus}$$ the percentile times SE(\hat{\theta}).
